overall_summary: Analysis of the performance data reveals a clear outlier preference for husband-wife relationship and domestic emotional dynamics over abstract heartbreak poetry. Specific relationship realities dramatically outperform generic sad shayari.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,679 views) massively outperform other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Focus core content production on relatable marital and long-term relationship pain-points.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a direct question or realization about everyday bonds get significantly higher engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational, highly relatable questions about domestic life as hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 21 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or abstract lines; ground the emotions in real household scenarios.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister emotional video (jfmMztnam_A) got 19 views due to weak execution or initial distribution.
weak_patterns.action: Rely on proven high-performing family/relationship sub-niches rather than scattering across too many disjointed topics.
